argv: A walk's end moved back where it went quiet cannot be moved forward again
ops.body: - [owner] A walk's end moved back where it went quiet cannot be moved forward again in the app (forgotten-stop, decision 0272): the readings after it stay stored (Share GPS log holds them), but no control undoes End it; none was drawn. The diff review's steward (silent 1, Nov 28): a moved end has no Undo while a delete has one (0041, D5); should End it, a correction of truth "like a delete", be undoable while its readings are still stored? A later slice could offer it in the walk's More (⋯) (low)

argv: Map, walk screen and motion polish
ops.body: - [owner] The recording bar reads "20:00" for a walk running twenty hours, just under "This walk went quiet at 5:19 am yesterday." (forgotten-stop's diff review, the steward's silent 2, Nov 28; `barTime`, h:mm): beside a clock time it reads as one. Should the bar say a time in hours in words past an hour, as the strip does ("20 h 01 min")? (low)

argv: Map, walk screen and motion polish
ops.body: - [owner] The Stop's quiet ask puts End it, the default, leading in a row, as the approved drawing does (forgotten-stop, decision 0276; the diff review's ux 4, Nov 28); the HIG and Material put the default action trailing, Cancel leading, as the More's ask and the Delete confirm now do. Mirror the Stop's ask to match? (low)

argv: Map, walk screen and motion polish
ops.body: - [loop] The More (⋯) row "End it where it went quiet" arrives after its own read, between Rename and Share GPS log, so a tap aimed at Share GPS log can land on it; and a tap on the backdrop closes the sheet while End it is under way, so a later failure is never shown (`WalkActions.tsx`; forgotten-stop's diff review, auditor 9, Nov 28): show the rows once both reads answer, and ignore the backdrop while ending (low)

- [ ] **Do:** with VoiceOver (iOS) or TalkBack (Android) on, hold Stop on a walk gone quiet on the walk screen, then swipe on past the card; then with the recording bar's ask up on Chronicle, switch tabs and tap the page. **Expect:** the card is not modal: focus lands on "This walk went quiet at …", then End it and Keep it all, and swiping on reaches the camera, the mic and the note beside it; on a phone the bar's ask closes on another tab, Back or a capture kept into the walk (a tap on the page closes it on the web only), ending nothing (forgotten-stop audit 13, 14).
